news.title: Mizzou helps Smithsonian map more than 200 years of nature’s progress
news.summary_en: Scientists across the country are working together to uncover how ecosystems have transformed since Lewis and Clark’s historic expedition and what the changes mean for America today.

news.title: Mizzou releases spring 2026 dean’s list
news.summary_en: More than 12,200 Tigers earned a spot on the list for exceptional grades.

news.title: Mizzou’s Gustin Golf Course supports wildlife and learning
news.summary_en: The course provides habitat for birds, bees and native plants while serving as a living laboratory for students and the community.
